purpose: Compare original and simplified controllers using the same packet sequences
design_timing: Exploratory definitions made after simplification proposals were frozen. Revision 2 corrects an oracle error exposed by the first preservation run; this is no longer a fully unseen acceptance check.
acceptance: Both variants must pass every selected case and have matching ordered tagged-packet endpoint observations. Missing/error evidence is inconclusive; inconclusive forwarding-table analyses are recorded, not counted as verified.
scope: Concrete ARP/IPv4 ICMP sequences in two fixed loop-free fixtures. No movement, policy updates, arbitrary packet equivalence, performance equivalence or formal proof.
isolation: Do not provide this directory, runner or its output to simplification or maintenance agents. Folder instructions provide workflow isolation, not an OS access boundary.

correction_history.reason: Corrected mistaken no-copies assertion for unknown MACs in another physical component. Local flooding is required; destination isolation remains required.

layout_note: File paths renamed for readability. Existing configuration/case IDs remain stable for matching historical evidence.
